In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment

 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

166	idx = [int(i) for i in metadata["frames_indices"]]

168	print("每帧时间戳(秒) =", timestamps)

197	### 4.2 时间戳编码机制：从 T-RoPE 到文本-时间戳对齐
198	
199	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
200	
201	Qwen2.5-VL 用 T-RoPE 处理视频时间：位置 id 的时间行随采样帧序号递增。这有两个先天限制：
202	
203	1. **只有序，没有量**：时间行编码的是「第 0 帧、第 2 帧、第 4 帧……」这样的相对次序，模型要靠训练隐式地猜「两帧之间隔了多久」，无法精确换算成秒。
204	2. **占用位置编码预算**：时间维挤占了多模态旋转位置编码的频段分配（u1-l1 提过 Interleaved-MRoPE 的动机之一就是把全频段留给更需要的位置维度）。
205	
206	Qwen3-VL 的官方表述（README「Model Architecture Updates」第 3 条）：
207	
208	[README.md:L54](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L54) —— 「Text–Timestamp Alignment: Moves beyond T-RoPE to precise, timestamp-grounded event localization for stronger video temporal modeling」，即超越 T-RoPE，实现以时间戳为锚的精确事件定位。
209	
210	落点就是本讲的 metadata：**采样时把每一帧的绝对秒数（`frames_indices[i] / fps`）记录下来，随视觉输入显式交给模型**。这样「第 3 秒画面里有人举手」与文本里的「03:00」处在同一坐标系统下，模型可以 grounding 式地回答「事件发生在第几秒」。README 对这个开关的说明：
211	
212	[README.md:L422-L433](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L422-L433) —— 官方列出 `qwen-vl-utils` 的两处新变化：`image_patch_size`（14 对应 Qwen2.5-VL、16 对应 Qwen3-VL），以及 `return_video_metadata`（仅 Qwen3-VL，原因写着「Due to the new video processor」）；并给出两种调用对照——Qwen2.5-VL 直接 `process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True)`，Qwen3-VL 需要 `image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True`。
213	
214	需要划清边界的是：metadata 是 `qwen-vl-utils`（本仓库）这一侧的**生产端**；它被消费成什么（processor 如何把帧级时间戳换算到视觉网格、位置 id 的 t 维度在新模型里如何退化），代码在 transformers 与微调框架里。本仓库 `qwen-vl-finetune/qwenvl/data/rope2d.py` 中三代 `get_rope_index_*` 的对比（Qwen3-VL 版本里 t 维不再吃时间步进）会在 **u5-l4** 精读，这里先建立「时间信息从位置编码搬家到显式时间戳」的整体图景即可。
215	
216	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
217	
218	时间信息在两种代际协议下的运输路线对比：
219	
220	```text
221	Qwen2.5-VL（T-RoPE 协议）
222	  fetch_video 返回 (video, sample_fps)
223	      └─ sample_fps 汇入 video_kwargs['fps'] 列表
224	            └─ processor 由 fps 推时间步 → 写进 position_ids 的 t 行（隐式）
225	
226	Qwen3-VL（时间戳对齐协议）
227	  fetch_video 返回 (video, video_metadata)
228	      └─ metadata 里带 frames_indices/fps/total_num_frames（绝对时间可换算）
229	            └─ processor(text, videos, video_metadata=[...], ...)（显式）
230	```
231	
232	关键差异一句话：**旧协议把时间压进位置编码，新协议把时间作为数据随帧同行**。这也是为什么 4.4 节你会看到 `return_video_metadata=True` 时 `video_kwargs` 反而**不再**携带 `fps`——时间信息已经换了交通工具。

305	### 4.3 帧列表输入的合成 metadata
306	
307	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
308	
309	u2-l3 提过 `fetch_video` 支持把**一组图片**当视频输入（`video` 字段传 list）。这条路径没有解码器，因此没有「原视频帧率」「原视频帧号」可言——时间档案的原料缺失。解决办法是让用户**声明**采样参数，再据此**合成**一份 metadata：
310	
311	- `sample_fps`：这些图片是按每秒几帧的速率采出来的（README 示例注释写明「used to determine timestamps for each frame」）。
312	- `raw_fps`（可选）：原始视频的帧率，默认取 `sample_fps`。
313	
314	合成的目标只有一个：让下游以为它收到的是一段「时长 \( N/\text{sample\_fps} \) 秒」的普通视频。
315	
316	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
317	
318	设用户给了 \( N' \) 张图（补偶帧后为 \( N \) 帧，\( N = \lceil N'/2 \rceil \times 2 \)），声明的采样率为 \( f_s \)、原始帧率为 \( f_r \)（默认 \( f_r = f_s \)），则合成 metadata 为：
319	
320	\[ \text{fps} = f_r,\qquad \text{frames\_indices} = [0, 1, \dots, N-1],\qquad \text{total\_num\_frames} = \frac{N}{f_s} \times f_r \]
321	
322	它有一条**时长守恒**性质——不管 `raw_fps` 声明成多少，总时长不变：
323	
324	\[ \frac{\text{total\_num\_frames}}{\text{fps}} = \frac{(N/f_s)\times f_r}{f_r} = \frac{N}{f_s} \quad\text{（秒）} \]
325	
326	直觉解读：4 帧图片、`sample_fps=1`，就是宣称「这是一个 4 秒的视频，每秒一帧」。若再声明 `raw_fps=25`，则 `total_num_frames = 4 × 25 = 100`，意思是「等价的原始视频是 25fps、100 帧」，时长依然 4 秒——`raw_fps` 只改变「原视频多大多密」的观感标尺，不改变时间轴本身。
327	
328	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
329	
330	[qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:L415-L446](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L415-L446) —— `fetch_video` 的帧列表分支。先用 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 并发调用 `fetch_image`（每帧复用图像链路的像素预算逻辑），再补偶帧、取 `sample_fps`、合成 metadata：
331	
332	```python

335	process_info = ele.copy()
336	process_info.pop("type", None)
337	process_info.pop("video", None)

341	    futures = [
342	        executor.submit(fetch_image, {"image": video_element, **process_info}, image_patch_size)
343	        for video_element in ele["video"]
344	    ]
345	    image_list = [future.result() for future in futures]
346	
347	nframes = ceil_by_factor(len(image_list), FRAME_FACTOR)
348	if len(image_list) < nframes:
349	    image_list.extend([image_list[-1]] * (nframes - len(image_list)))   # 复制末帧补偶

351	sample_fps = ele.get("sample_fps", 2.0)
352	...
353	# fake video metadata
354	raw_fps = process_info.pop("raw_fps", sample_fps)
355	video_metadata = dict(
356	    fps=raw_fps,
357	    frames_indices=[i for i in range(len(video))],
358	    total_num_frames=(nframes / sample_fps) * raw_fps,
359	)
360	```

362	逐点说明：
363	
364	- **补偶帧**（L430-L432）：`ceil_by_factor(len, 2)` 保证帧数为偶数，不足就复制最后一帧——与 u2-l3 视频路径 `floor_by_factor` 的动机相同（时间维 2× 压缩，`FRAME_FACTOR=2`，见 [L31-L35](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L31-L35) 的常量定义）。

423	**需要观察的现象**：Part 2 中 `shape` 的帧维为 4、`frames_indices = [0, 1, 2, 3]`、`fps = 1.0`、`total_num_frames = 4.0`（注意是 float）、无 `video_backend` 键；`total_num_frames / fps = 4.0` 秒。

425	**预期结果**（由源码公式确定性推导，具体打印待本地验证）：
426	`nframes = ceil_by_factor(4, 2) = 4`，无需补帧；`fps = raw_fps = sample_fps = 1.0`；`total_num_frames = (4/1) × 1 = 4.0`。
427	
428	**`total_num_frames = 4.0` 的含义**：这 4 张图宣称以每秒 1 帧的速率采得，因此等价于一个「1fps、4 帧、4 秒」的完整视频；`total_num_frames ÷ fps = 4` 秒即其总时长。若把 `raw_fps` 改成 25（`{"video": frames, "sample_fps": 1.0, "raw_fps": 25.0}`），`total_num_frames` 变为 `(4/1)×25 = 100.0`，总时长依旧 `100/25 = 4` 秒——这就是 4.3.2 的时长守恒：`raw_fps` 只改「原视频标尺」，不改时间轴。
429	
430	**进阶观察**（可选）：只给 3 张图，看补偶帧——`nframes = ceil_by_factor(3, 2) = 4`，`video2.shape[0]` 仍是 4，第 4 帧是第 3 帧的复制；`frames_indices = [0, 1, 2, 3]` 与图片内容无关，只数张数。
431	
432	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
433	
434	**练习 1**：6 张图、`sample_fps=2`，合成 metadata 是什么？总时长多少？
435	
436	**答案**：`nframes = 6`（已偶）；`fps = 2.0`；`frames_indices = [0..5]`；`total_num_frames = (6/2)×2 = 6.0`；总时长 = 6/2 = **3 秒**，即每帧间隔 0.5 秒。
437	
438	**练习 2**：用户传 `sample_fps=1, raw_fps=24`，共 5 张图。求补帧后的张量帧数、`total_num_frames` 与总时长，并说明 `raw_fps` 改变了什么、没改变什么。
439	
440	**答案**：`nframes = ceil_by_factor(5,2) = 6`（末帧复制 1 次）；`total_num_frames = (6/1)×24 = 144.0`；总时长 = 144/24 = **6 秒**（= 6 帧 ÷ 1fps）。`raw_fps` 改变的是「等价原视频的帧数标尺」（6 → 144），没改变时间轴（仍 6 秒）与帧间隔（1 秒）。
441	
442	**练习 3**：为什么帧列表分支的 `frames_indices` 是 `[0,1,...,N-1]` 这种「假帧号」，而不尝试还原原视频里的真实帧号？
443	
444	**答案**：因为这条路径根本没有原视频——图片列表可能来自任何地方（截图、抽帧后丢掉源文件、甚至纯合成序列），库无从得知也无法验证真实帧号。它只能以「子序列序号 + 用户声明的时间参数」构造一个自洽的时间档案，把「这组帧等价于多长的视频」这一最小必要信息交给下游；源码注释「fake video metadata」正是在坦诚这一点。
445	
446	### 4.4 video_kwargs 的传递链路与版本兼容策略
447	
448	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
449	
450	`video_kwargs` 是 `process_vision_info(..., return_video_kwargs=True)` 的第三个返回值，它的职责是**告诉 processor 采样这件事已经做完了、以及该按哪代协议理解视频输入**。它很小，却是新旧两代模型共用同一个库的关键兼容层：
451	
452	- 恒有 `do_sample_frames: False`——帧已在 `qwen-vl-utils` 内按 `smart_nframes` 采完，processor 不要再按 fps 二次抽帧（否则时间戳与画面全部错位）。
453	- 仅在 **Qwen2.5 兼容模式**（`return_video_metadata=False`）下额外带 `fps: [每个视频的实际采样率]`，供旧 processor 构造 T-RoPE 时间步。
454	- Qwen3 模式下时间信息走 metadata 元组，`fps` 列表不再出现。
455	
456	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
457	
458	```text
459	process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=?)
460	        │ 对每个 video 元素：
461	        │   fetch_video(vision_info, return_video_sample_fps=True,   ← 恒开
462	        │               image_patch_size=..., return_video_metadata=?)
463	        │   sample_fps 收进 video_sample_fps_list
464	        ▼
465	video_kwargs = {'do_sample_frames': False}
466	        │
467	        ├── return_video_metadata=False（Qwen2.5 兼容）
468	        │       └─ video_kwargs['fps'] = video_sample_fps_list
469	        │
470	        └── return_video_metadata=True（Qwen3）
471	                └─ 时间信息在 (video, metadata) 元组里，kwargs 不含 fps
472	        ▼
473	transformers: processor(text, videos=videos, video_metadata=[...], **video_kwargs)
474	vLLM:         {'prompt', 'multi_modal_data': {'video': [(v, meta), ...]},
475	               'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs}
476	```
477	
478	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
479	
480	[qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:L513-L534](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L513-L534) —— `process_vision_info` 的分发与 kwargs 组装。视频元素**恒以** `return_video_sample_fps=True` 调用 `fetch_video`（所以 `sample_fps` 总会被算出来），但它是否对外可见取决于 `return_video_metadata`：
481	
482	```python
483	elif "video" in vision_info:
484	    video_input, video_sample_fps = fetch_video(vision_info, return_video_sample_fps=True,
485	                image_patch_size=image_patch_size, return_video_metadata=return_video_metadata)
486	    video_sample_fps_list.append(video_sample_fps)
487	    video_inputs.append(video_input)
488	...
489	video_kwargs = {'do_sample_frames': False}
490	if not return_video_metadata: # BC for qwen2.5vl
491	    video_kwargs.update({'fps': video_sample_fps_list})
492	```
493	
494	那句 `# BC for qwen2.5vl`（backward compatibility）就是两代协议的分岔口。下游两种接法：
495	
496	**transformers 直用**（官方示例）：
497	
498	[README.md:L639-L651](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L639-L651) —— 先用 `zip(*videos)` 把「(video, metadata) 元组的列表」拆成「张量列表 + metadata 列表」两个平行列表，再连同 `do_resize=False`（u2-l2 讲过：库内已缩放，防重复）一起喂给 processor：
499	
500	```python
501	images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
502	    messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True)
503	
504	# split the videos and according metadatas
505	if videos is not None:
506	    videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos)
507	    videos, video_metadatas = list(videos), list(video_metadatas)
508	else:
509	    video_metadatas = None
510	
511	inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos,
512	                   video_metadata=video_metadatas, return_tensors="pt",
513	                   do_resize=False, **video_kwargs)
514	```
515	
516	**vLLM 路径**：
517	
518	[README.md:L997-L1018](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L997-L1018) —— `prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 模式（u1-l4、u3-l2 都见过它）：这里**不拆包**，`video_inputs` 里的 `(video, metadata)` 元组原样放进 `multi_modal_data['video']`，`video_kwargs` 整体作为 `mm_processor_kwargs` 透传，由 vLLM 内部的 Qwen3-VL processor 解包消费：
519	
520	```python
521	image_inputs, video_inputs, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
522	    messages,
523	    image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size,
524	    return_video_kwargs=True,
525	    return_video_metadata=True
526	)
527	...
528	return {
529	    'prompt': text,
530	    'multi_modal_data': mm_data,          # video 是 (张量, metadata) 元组列表
531	    'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs   # {'do_sample_frames': False}
532	}
533	```
534	
535	顺带注意这里的最佳实践：`image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size` 动态取自模型配置（u2-l1 推荐过），避免硬编码 14/16 造成静默错配。
536	
537	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
538	
539	**实践目标**：走通「拆包 → processor」完整一跳，确认 metadata 与 `do_sample_frames` 都正确到达 processor。
540	
541	**操作步骤**：
542	
543	```python
544	from transformers import AutoProcessor
545	from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info
546	
547	MODEL = "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct"
548	processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(MODEL)
549	
550	messages = [{
551	    "role": "user",
552	    "content": [
553	        {"type": "video", "video": "file:///path/to/demo.mp4"},
554	        {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."},
555	    ],
556	}]
557	
558	text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
559	images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
560	    messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True)
561	
562	videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos)
563	videos, video_metadatas = list(videos), list(video_metadatas)
564	print("video_kwargs      =", video_kwargs)          # 期望只有 do_sample_frames
565	print("video_metadatas[0]的键 =", list(video_metadatas[0].keys()))
566	
567	inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos,
568	                   video_metadata=video_metadatas,
569	                   return_tensors="pt", do_resize=False, **video_kwargs)
570	print({k: tuple(v.shape) for k, v in inputs.items() if hasattr(v, "shape")})
571	```
572	
573	**需要观察的现象**：`video_kwargs` 只含 `{'do_sample_frames': False}`；metadata 键为 `fps / frames_indices / total_num_frames / video_backend` 四项；inputs 中出现 `pixel_values_videos` 等视觉张量。
574	
575	**预期结果**：processor 正常产出张量；若漏传 `video_metadata` 或忘开 `return_video_metadata`，Qwen3-VL 的 processor 可能报缺参错误或静默走旧逻辑（取决于 transformers 版本）——待本地验证你所用版本的具体行为。
576	
577	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
578	
579	**练习 1**：`do_sample_frames: False` 为什么必须恒为 False？什么场景下会出问题？
580	
581	**答案**：因为 `qwen-vl-utils` 已在库内完成 `smart_nframes` 抽帧并**基于抽出的帧号**生成了 metadata 时间戳；若 processor 再按 fps 二次抽帧，画面帧数变了而 metadata 还是旧帧号，时间戳与画面将整体错位。只要走 `process_vision_info` 预处理路径，这个键就必须带上且为 False。
582	
583	**练习 2**：`video_kwargs['fps']` 是列表而不是单个数，为什么？
584	
585	**答案**：因为一条 messages 里可以有多个视频（u1-l3 的多视频输入），`video_sample_fps_list` 按顺序记录每个视频的实际采样率，processor 需要按同样顺序为各视频构造时间步；列表长度即视频个数。
586	
587	**练习 3**：transformers 路径要 `zip(*videos)` 拆包，vLLM 路径却不拆，为什么？
588	
589	**答案**：接口约定不同。transformers 的 `processor(...)` 参数要求 `videos`（张量列表）与 `video_metadata`（dict 列表）是两个平行参数，所以必须拆；vLLM 的 `multi_modal_data['video']` 约定每项就是 `(video, metadata)` 元组，由 vLLM 内部再转交给 processor，因此原样放入即可。两种接法运输的是同一份时间档案，只是封装不同。
590	
591	## 5. 综合实践
592	
593	**任务：给一段视频建立「采样方案 → 时间轴」对照表，并验证帧列表合成 metadata 的时长等价性。**
594	
595	1. 准备一段 10~30 秒的本地 mp4。
596	2. 对它分别用 `fps=1.0` 与 `fps=4.0` 两次调用 `fetch_video(ele, image_patch_size=16, return_video_metadata=True, return_video_sample_fps=True)`。
597	3. 对每次结果，用 `frames_indices / fps` 手算全部采样帧的时间戳，填入对照表：采样方案 ｜ 抽出帧数 ｜ 实际 sample_fps ｜ 前 5 帧时间戳 ｜ 总时长。验证：帧数符合 u2-l3 的 `smart_nframes` 公式；两种方案的总时长一致（同一视频）。
598	4. 把 `fps=1.0` 方案抽出的前 4 帧用 `torchvision.utils.save_image` 存成 jpg，再作为图片列表 + `sample_fps=1.0` 重新喂给 `fetch_video`；比较合成 metadata 的总时长与第 3 步的真实总时长（应等于 4 帧 × 1 秒 = 4 秒），并用一段话解释「fake metadata」为何仍然自洽（提示：时长守恒公式）。
599	5. 把以上结果整理进你的 `notes.md`。全程不需要 GPU；运行数值待本地验证。
600	
601	这个任务把本讲四个模块串成一条线：真实 metadata 的生产（4.1）→ 时间戳换算（4.2）→ 帧列表合成与守恒（4.3）→ 采样完成标记与传参（4.4）。
602	
603	## 6. 本讲小结
604	
605	- `video_metadata` 是采样过程的时间档案：`fps`（原帧率）、`frames_indices`（采样帧的原视频帧号）、`total_num_frames`（原视频/区间总帧数）、`video_backend`（溯源）；帧时间戳 = `frames_indices[i] / fps`，总时长 = `total_num_frames / fps`。
606	- Qwen3-VL 用「文本-时间戳对齐」取代 T-RoPE：时间不再隐式藏进位置编码，而是由 metadata 显式随帧同行，支撑秒级事件定位；这是 `return_video_metadata` 开关存在的根本原因。
607	- `sample_fps`（实际采样率 = nframes ÷ 视频时长）只在 Qwen2.5 兼容分支进入 `video_kwargs['fps']`；Qwen3 模式下时间信息全部由 metadata 承载。
608	- 帧列表输入时库会「fake」一份 metadata：`fps = raw_fps`、`frames_indices = [0..N-1]`、`total_num_frames = (N/sample_fps)×raw_fps`，满足时长守恒 \( \text{total\_num\_frames}/\text{fps} = N/\text{sample\_fps} \)；不足偶数帧会复制末帧补齐。
609	- `video_kwargs` 恒带 `do_sample_frames: False`（帧已在库内采样，禁止 processor 二次抽帧）；transformers 路径要 `zip(*videos)` 拆出 `video_metadata` 平行列表，vLLM 路径则把 `(video, metadata)` 元组直接放进 `multi_modal_data`。
610	- 两个易踩的坑：torchvision 与 decord/torchcodec 的 `frames_indices` 类型不同（Tensor vs list）；设 `video_start/video_end` 后 `total_num_frames` 变区间帧数而帧号仍是绝对值。
611	
612	## 7. 下一步学习建议
613	
614	- 下一讲 **u3-l1（深入 processor）**：metadata 交给 processor 之后发生什么——chat template 渲染出 `<|video_pad|>`、像素预算如何从 processor 侧配置，是本讲 4.4 传参链路的直接下游。
615	- 若你想立刻追进「模型内部」，可提前阅读 **u5-l4（rope2d.py：三代 MRoPE 位置编码）**：那里对比 `get_rope_index_2/25/3`，你会看到 Qwen2.5-VL 的 t 维时间步进如何被 Qwen3-VL 淘汰（t_index 恒 0），从位置编码侧印证本讲的时间戳对齐设计。
616	- 建议顺手源码回看两处：[vision_process.py:L528-L530](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L528-L530)（`# BC for qwen2.5vl` 分岔口）与 [README.md:L54](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L54)（官方对 Text–Timestamp Alignment 的一句话定位），它们是理解整条视频时间链路的两枚路标。

# u2-l4 video metadata 与 Qwen3-VL 时间戳对齐机制

> 讲义 ID：u2-l4 ｜ 层级：intermediate ｜ 依赖：u2-l3（视频链路与三种解码后端）
> 关键源码：`qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py`、`README.md`

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `video_metadata` 字典中 `fps`、`frames_indices`、`total_num_frames`（以及 `video_backend`）各字段时间语义，并手算「第 i 个采样帧对应视频第几秒」。
2. 解释 Qwen3-VL 为什么放弃 Qwen2.5-VL 的 T-RoPE 绝对时间位置编码，改为「文本-时间戳对齐」，以及 `return_video_metadata` 这个开关在其中扮演的角色。
3. 在没有视频文件、只有一组图片帧时，用 `sample_fps`（必要时加 `raw_fps`）构造出带时间信息的视频输入，并读懂合成的 `video_metadata`。
4. 理清 `video_kwargs` 在「Qwen2.5 兼容模式」与「Qwen3 模式」两条分支下的不同内容，以及它一路传到 processor / vLLM 的完整链路。

## 2. 前置知识

在进入源码之前，先统一几个本讲反复使用的基础概念：

- **帧率（fps, frames per second）**：视频每秒包含多少帧。一个 `25fps、250 帧` 的视频时长就是 \( 250/25 = 10 \) 秒。反过来，**帧号 ÷ 帧率 = 该帧出现的秒数**，这是本讲最重要的一把换算尺。
- **原始帧率 vs 采样率**：u2-l3 讲过 `smart_nframes` 会按你指定的 `fps`（默认 2.0）从原视频里均匀抽帧。抽完之后「实际每秒保留了几个帧」叫**实际采样率**（源码里的 `sample_fps`），它不一定等于你请求的值——因为帧数会被夹进 `[4, 768]` 区间并向下取偶。
- **T-RoPE 是什么**：Qwen2.5-VL 的多模态旋转位置编码把位置 id 排成时间/高/宽三行，其中时间行按「第几个采样帧」递增。也就是说，时间信息被**隐式地编码进位置编码**里，模型只能「感觉到」先后顺序，不能直接知道「这是第 3.5 秒」。
- **时间戳对齐（Text–Timestamp Alignment）**：Qwen3-VL 的做法是把每一帧的**绝对时间（第几秒）**作为显式信息随视觉输入一起交给模型，让画面内容与文本里的「00:05」这类时间表述直接对齐。本讲的主角 `video_metadata` 就是这些时间信息的载体。
- **字典即数据契约**：`video_metadata` 不是什么特殊类，就是一个普通 Python `dict`，由 `qwen-vl-utils` 生产、交给 processor（transformers 侧）消费。理解了字段语义，你就理解了整条链路。

另外回顾 u2-l3 的两个结论，本讲直接使用：帧数恒为偶数（`FRAME_FACTOR=2`，时间维 2× 压缩）；解码后端优先级 torchcodec > decord > torchvision，任一后端失败自动回退 torchvision。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 本讲关注点 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 video_metadata 的结构与各字段的时间语义

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

当你用 `return_video_metadata=True` 调用 `process_vision_info`（或直接调 `fetch_video`）时，每个视频的返回值从「裸张量」变成「(张量, metadata) 元组」。metadata 记录的是**采样过程的时间档案**：这段张量里的每一帧，是从原视频的哪个位置抽出来的、原视频有多长、以什么帧率播放。

它解决的问题是：模型拿到的视频张量经过抽帧与缩放后，**时间信息全部丢失**——张量只是一个 `(T, C, H, W)` 的数组，谁也不知道第 0 帧和第 1 帧之间隔了 0.5 秒还是 3 秒。metadata 就是把这些丢掉的时间信息打包随身携带。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

三个解码后端构造 metadata 的步骤完全同构：

1. 解码器探测原视频的 `total_frames`（总帧数）与 `video_fps`（原始帧率）。
2. `smart_nframes`（u2-l3 精读过）算出要抽的帧数 `nframes`。
3. 用 `linspace(起点帧, 终点帧, nframes)` **均匀**选出帧号列表 `frames_indices`。
4. 计算**实际采样率**：

\[ \text{sample\_fps} = \frac{\text{nframes}}{\text{total\_frames}} \times \text{video\_fps} = \frac{\text{nframes}}{\text{视频时长（秒）}} \]

5. 打包成字典：`fps`（原帧率）、`frames_indices`（采样帧号）、`total_num_frames`（总帧数）、`video_backend`（后端名）。

有了它，两个关键时间量都能手算：

\[ t_i = \frac{\text{frames\_indices}[i]}{\text{fps}} \quad\text{（第 } i \text{ 个采样帧出现的秒数）} \]

\[ T_{\text{total}} = \frac{\text{total\_num\_frames}}{\text{fps}} \quad\text{（视频总时长，单位秒）} \]

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看 torchvision 后端（另外两个后端逻辑相同）：

[qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:L214-L225](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L214-L225) —— `smart_nframes` 定帧数后，`linspace` 在 `[0, total_frames-1]` 上均匀取 `nframes` 个帧号；`sample_fps` 按「抽出的帧数 ÷ 原时长」计算；最后把 `fps / frames_indices / total_num_frames / video_backend` 四个字段打包返回：

idx = torch.linspace(0, total_frames - 1, nframes).round().long()
sample_fps = nframes / max(total_frames, 1e-6) * video_fps

字段语义总结表：

| 字段 | 含义 | 时间换算 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fps` | 原视频帧率（解码器报告值） | 换算尺的分母 |
| `frames_indices` | 采样帧在**原视频**中的帧号 | 第 i 帧时间 = `frames_indices[i] / fps` |
| `total_num_frames` | 原视频总帧数（设 `video_start/video_end` 时为区间内帧数，见下） | 总时长 = `total_num_frames / fps` |

两个容易踩的细节，均直接来自源码：

- **类型差异**：torchvision 后端的 `frames_indices` 是 `torch.Tensor`（L215 没有 `.tolist()`），decord / torchcodec 是 Python `list`（L317、L366 调了 `.tolist()`）。打印时形态不同，做时间戳计算时注意统一转 `int`。
- **截取区间会改写 `total_num_frames` 的含义**：[vision_process.py:L310-L317](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L310-L317) 中，decord 后端先用 `calculate_video_frame_range` 把 `total_frames` **覆盖**为区间内帧数，但 `idx = linspace(start_frame, end_frame, nframes)` 里的帧号仍是**原视频的绝对帧号**。因此设了 `video_start/video_end` 后：`total_num_frames / fps` 是**区间时长**，而 `frames_indices[i] / fps` 仍是**相对整个视频的绝对时间戳**。该函数的定义在 [vision_process.py:L234-L289](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L234-L289)：未设区间时直接返回 `(0, total_frames-1, total_frames)`（L262-L263），设了则按秒换算成起止帧并校验顺序（L267-L289）。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：对一段真实视频拿到 metadata，手算每帧时间戳，与库返回的 `sample_fps` 互相印证。

**操作步骤**（示例代码，可直接保存为 `inspect_metadata.py` 运行）：

```python
from qwen_vl_utils.vision_process import fetch_video

# 注意：process_vision_info 内部恒以 return_video_sample_fps=True 调 fetch_video，
# 直接调 fetch_video 时需要显式传这两个开关。
ele = {"video": "file:///path/to/demo.mp4", "fps": 2.0}

(video, metadata), sample_fps = fetch_video(
    ele,
    image_patch_size=16,              # Qwen3-VL 必须传 16（见 u2-l1）
    return_video_metadata=True,
    return_video_sample_fps=True,
)

print("video.shape =", tuple(video.shape))       # (T, C, H, W)
print("sample_fps  =", sample_fps)
print("fps               =", metadata["fps"])
print("frames_indices    =", metadata["frames_indices"])
print("total_num_frames  =", metadata["total_num_frames"])
print("video_backend     =", metadata.get("video_backend"))

# 手算时间戳：帧号 / 原帧率
idx = [int(i) for i in metadata["frames_indices"]]
timestamps = [round(i / metadata["fps"], 3) for i in idx]
print("每帧时间戳(秒) =", timestamps)
print("总时长(秒)     =", metadata["total_num_frames"] / metadata["fps"])

# 印证：sample_fps == nframes / 总时长
print("nframes / T =", video.shape[0] / (metadata["total_num_frames"] / metadata["fps"]))
```

**需要观察的现象**：

- `video.shape[0]`（帧数 T）是偶数（`FRAME_FACTOR=2`，u2-l3 讲过）。
- `frames_indices` 是从 0 到 `total_num_frames-1` 的**近似等差**序列（`linspace` 均匀采样）。
- 最后一个打印值应与 `sample_fps` 相等。

**预期结果**：以一个 `25fps、10 秒、250 帧` 的视频、`fps=2.0` 请求为例，按源码公式推导：`nframes = 10 × 2 = 20`，`frames_indices ≈ [0, 13, 26, ...]`（250 帧里均匀取 20 个），`sample_fps = 20/10 = 2.0`，`总时长 = 250/25 = 10.0` 秒。若视频短于 2 秒，帧数会被 `FPS_MIN_FRAMES=4` 抬底，此时 `sample_fps = 4 / 时长 > 2`，不再等于请求值——这正是「实际采样率」要单独返回的原因。以上数值由源码公式推导，具体打印值待本地验证。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：一个 `30fps、总 303 帧` 的视频，`frames_indices = [0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150]`。求每个采样帧的时间戳与实际采样率。

**答案**：时间戳 = 帧号 ÷ 30，即 `[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` 秒；实际采样率 = 6 帧 ÷ (303/30 ≈ 10.1 秒) ≈ 0.593 fps。注意它小于常见的请求值 2.0——因为帧数被 `floor_by_factor` 取偶及 `max_frames` 上限约束后，实际抽到的密度由公式 \( \text{nframes}/T \) 决定，而非请求值。

**练习 2**：为什么 metadata 里 `total_num_frames` 是「原视频总帧数」而不是「抽出来的帧数」？后者从哪能拿到？

**答案**：抽出来的帧数就是返回张量的 `video.shape[0]`，调用方天然可见，无需重复；而原视频总帧数在抽样后彻底丢失，它是计算**视频总时长**（`total_num_frames / fps`）的唯一依据，必须随张量一并带出。

**练习 3**：设了 `video_start=10, video_end=20`（decord 后端）后，`total_num_frames / fps` 与 `frames_indices[i] / fps` 分别表示什么？

**答案**：前者是**截取区间**的时长（约 10 秒），因为 [L311-L315](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L310-L317) 用区间帧数覆盖了 `total_frames`；后者仍是**相对原视频的绝对时间戳**（例如第 12.4 秒），因为 `idx` 里存的是原视频绝对帧号。

### 4.2 时间戳编码机制：从 T-RoPE 到文本-时间戳对齐

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

Qwen2.5-VL 用 T-RoPE 处理视频时间：位置 id 的时间行随采样帧序号递增。这有两个先天限制：

1. **只有序，没有量**：时间行编码的是「第 0 帧、第 2 帧、第 4 帧……」这样的相对次序，模型要靠训练隐式地猜「两帧之间隔了多久」，无法精确换算成秒。
2. **占用位置编码预算**：时间维挤占了多模态旋转位置编码的频段分配（u1-l1 提过 Interleaved-MRoPE 的动机之一就是把全频段留给更需要的位置维度）。

Qwen3-VL 的官方表述（README「Model Architecture Updates」第 3 条）：

[README.md:L54](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L54) —— 「Text–Timestamp Alignment: Moves beyond T-RoPE to precise, timestamp-grounded event localization for stronger video temporal modeling」，即超越 T-RoPE，实现以时间戳为锚的精确事件定位。

落点就是本讲的 metadata：**采样时把每一帧的绝对秒数（`frames_indices[i] / fps`）记录下来，随视觉输入显式交给模型**。这样「第 3 秒画面里有人举手」与文本里的「03:00」处在同一坐标系统下，模型可以 grounding 式地回答「事件发生在第几秒」。README 对这个开关的说明：

[README.md:L422-L433](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L422-L433) —— 官方列出 `qwen-vl-utils` 的两处新变化：`image_patch_size`（14 对应 Qwen2.5-VL、16 对应 Qwen3-VL），以及 `return_video_metadata`（仅 Qwen3-VL，原因写着「Due to the new video processor」）；并给出两种调用对照——Qwen2.5-VL 直接 `process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True)`，Qwen3-VL 需要 `image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True`。

需要划清边界的是：metadata 是 `qwen-vl-utils`（本仓库）这一侧的**生产端**；它被消费成什么（processor 如何把帧级时间戳换算到视觉网格、位置 id 的 t 维度在新模型里如何退化），代码在 transformers 与微调框架里。本仓库 `qwen-vl-finetune/qwenvl/data/rope2d.py` 中三代 `get_rope_index_*` 的对比（Qwen3-VL 版本里 t 维不再吃时间步进）会在 **u5-l4** 精读，这里先建立「时间信息从位置编码搬家到显式时间戳」的整体图景即可。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

时间信息在两种代际协议下的运输路线对比：

```text
Qwen2.5-VL（T-RoPE 协议）
  fetch_video 返回 (video, sample_fps)
      └─ sample_fps 汇入 video_kwargs['fps'] 列表
            └─ processor 由 fps 推时间步 → 写进 position_ids 的 t 行（隐式）

Qwen3-VL（时间戳对齐协议）
  fetch_video 返回 (video, video_metadata)
      └─ metadata 里带 frames_indices/fps/total_num_frames（绝对时间可换算）
            └─ processor(text, videos, video_metadata=[...], ...)（显式）
```

关键差异一句话：**旧协议把时间压进位置编码，新协议把时间作为数据随帧同行**。这也是为什么 4.4 节你会看到 `return_video_metadata=True` 时 `video_kwargs` 反而**不再**携带 `fps`——时间信息已经换了交通工具。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

[qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:L477-L480](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L477-L480) —— `fetch_video` 的收尾：把 metadata 与视频张量**绑成一个元组**作为最终返回，这正是「时间信息随帧同行」在代码层面的形态：

```python
final_video = (video, video_metadata) if return_video_metadata else video
if return_video_sample_fps:
    return final_video, sample_fps
return final_video
```

注意返回结构随开关变化的规则（后面拆包时要用）：

| 开关组合 | 返回值 |
| --- | --- |
| 两个都 False | `video` |
| 仅 `return_video_sample_fps=True` | `(video, sample_fps)` |
| 仅 `return_video_metadata=True` | `(video, metadata)` |
| 两个都 True | `((video, metadata), sample_fps)` |

而 `process_vision_info` 层面永远以 `return_video_sample_fps=True` 调用（见 4.4.3），所以从 `process_vision_info` 出来的每个视频元素是 `(video, metadata)` 元组（Qwen3 模式）或 `(video, sample_fps)` 中被剥掉 fps 后的 `video`（Qwen2.5 模式）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：用一句话向同事解释「Qwen3-VL 的时间戳对齐比 T-RoPE 强在哪」。

**答案**：T-RoPE 只把「帧的先后次序」编码进位置 id，时间是被隐式猜测的；时间戳对齐把每帧的**绝对秒数**（由 `frames_indices/fps` 换算）作为显式数据随视觉输入提供给模型，因此能做「事件发生在第几秒」的精确定位，而不只是顺序感知。

**练习 2**：如果调用方在 Qwen3 模式下忘了传 `return_video_metadata=True`，会发生什么？

**答案**：不会报错，但时间信息会退化成 Qwen2.5 协议——`video_kwargs` 里带 `fps` 列表、视频是裸张量、没有 metadata。processor 拿不到 `video_metadata`，时间戳对齐无从谈起；且若 processor 按新协议期望 metadata，行为不可预期。这属于 u2-l1 提过的「静默错配」家族：类型/开关传错不抛异常，只是结果悄悄变差。

**练习 3**：`sample_fps`（实际采样率）在 Qwen3 模式下还需要吗？它去哪了？

**答案**：metadata 路径下它不再进 `video_kwargs`（L529-L530 只在 `not return_video_metadata` 时写入 `fps` 列表）。它仍由 `fetch_video` 计算并返回，但只在 Qwen2.5 兼容分支被消费；Qwen3 的时间换算完全基于 metadata 的 `frames_indices` 与 `fps`。

### 4.3 帧列表输入的合成 metadata

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

u2-l3 提过 `fetch_video` 支持把**一组图片**当视频输入（`video` 字段传 list）。这条路径没有解码器，因此没有「原视频帧率」「原视频帧号」可言——时间档案的原料缺失。解决办法是让用户**声明**采样参数，再据此**合成**一份 metadata：

- `sample_fps`：这些图片是按每秒几帧的速率采出来的（README 示例注释写明「used to determine timestamps for each frame」）。
- `raw_fps`（可选）：原始视频的帧率，默认取 `sample_fps`。

合成的目标只有一个：让下游以为它收到的是一段「时长 \( N/\text{sample\_fps} \) 秒」的普通视频。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

设用户给了 \( N' \) 张图（补偶帧后为 \( N \) 帧，\( N = \lceil N'/2 \rceil \times 2 \)），声明的采样率为 \( f_s \)、原始帧率为 \( f_r \)（默认 \( f_r = f_s \)），则合成 metadata 为：

\[ \text{fps} = f_r,\qquad \text{frames\_indices} = [0, 1, \dots, N-1],\qquad \text{total\_num\_frames} = \frac{N}{f_s} \times f_r \]

它有一条**时长守恒**性质——不管 `raw_fps` 声明成多少，总时长不变：

\[ \frac{\text{total\_num\_frames}}{\text{fps}} = \frac{(N/f_s)\times f_r}{f_r} = \frac{N}{f_s} \quad\text{（秒）} \]

直觉解读：4 帧图片、`sample_fps=1`，就是宣称「这是一个 4 秒的视频，每秒一帧」。若再声明 `raw_fps=25`，则 `total_num_frames = 4 × 25 = 100`，意思是「等价的原始视频是 25fps、100 帧」，时长依然 4 秒——`raw_fps` 只改变「原视频多大多密」的观感标尺，不改变时间轴本身。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:L415-L446](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L415-L446) —— `fetch_video` 的帧列表分支。先用 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 并发调用 `fetch_image`（每帧复用图像链路的像素预算逻辑），再补偶帧、取 `sample_fps`、合成 metadata：

```python
# The input is a list of frames
assert isinstance(ele["video"], (list, tuple))
process_info = ele.copy()
process_info.pop("type", None)
process_info.pop("video", None)
# use ThreadPoolExecutor to parallel process frames
max_workers = min(MAX_NUM_WORKERS_FETCH_VIDEO, len(ele["video"]))
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
    futures = [
        executor.submit(fetch_image, {"image": video_element, **process_info}, image_patch_size)
        for video_element in ele["video"]
    ]
    image_list = [future.result() for future in futures]

nframes = ceil_by_factor(len(image_list), FRAME_FACTOR)
if len(image_list) < nframes:
    image_list.extend([image_list[-1]] * (nframes - len(image_list)))   # 复制末帧补偶

sample_fps = ele.get("sample_fps", 2.0)
...
# fake video metadata
raw_fps = process_info.pop("raw_fps", sample_fps)
video_metadata = dict(
    fps=raw_fps,
    frames_indices=[i for i in range(len(video))],
    total_num_frames=(nframes / sample_fps) * raw_fps,
)
```

逐点说明：

- **补偶帧**（L430-L432）：`ceil_by_factor(len, 2)` 保证帧数为偶数，不足就复制最后一帧——与 u2-l3 视频路径 `floor_by_factor` 的动机相同（时间维 2× 压缩，`FRAME_FACTOR=2`，见 [L31-L35](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L31-L35) 的常量定义）。
- **`sample_fps` 默认 2.0**（L434）：与视频路径的默认采样 `FPS = 2.0` 保持一致的时间假设。
- **源码自己承认这是合成品**：注释「fake video metadata」。注意它与真实 metadata 的两处差别：没有 `video_backend` 字段；`total_num_frames` 是**浮点数**（除法所致），而文件路径产出的是整数。打印时看到 `4.0` 不要惊讶。
- **`frames_indices` 是 0..N-1 的连续序号**：即「相对于这组帧自身的序号」。默认 `raw_fps = sample_fps` 时，帧 i 的时间戳 \( i / f_r = i / f_s \)（每帧间隔 \( 1/f_s \) 秒），时间轴自洽。

**练习 2**：用户传 `sample_fps=1, raw_fps=24`，共 5 张图。求补帧后的张量帧数、`total_num_frames` 与总时长，并说明 `raw_fps` 改变了什么、没改变什么。

**答案**：因为这条路径根本没有原视频——图片列表可能来自任何地方（截图、抽帧后丢掉源文件、甚至纯合成序列），库无从得知也无法验证真实帧号。它只能以「子序列序号 + 用户声明的时间参数」构造一个自洽的时间档案，把「这组帧等价于多长的视频」这一最小必要信息交给下游；源码注释「fake video metadata」正是在坦诚这一点。

### 4.4 video_kwargs 的传递链路与版本兼容策略

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

`video_kwargs` 是 `process_vision_info(..., return_video_kwargs=True)` 的第三个返回值，它的职责是**告诉 processor 采样这件事已经做完了、以及该按哪代协议理解视频输入**。它很小，却是新旧两代模型共用同一个库的关键兼容层：

- 恒有 `do_sample_frames: False`——帧已在 `qwen-vl-utils` 内按 `smart_nframes` 采完，processor 不要再按 fps 二次抽帧（否则时间戳与画面全部错位）。
- 仅在 **Qwen2.5 兼容模式**（`return_video_metadata=False`）下额外带 `fps: [每个视频的实际采样率]`，供旧 processor 构造 T-RoPE 时间步。
- Qwen3 模式下时间信息走 metadata 元组，`fps` 列表不再出现。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=?)
        │ 对每个 video 元素：
        │   fetch_video(vision_info, return_video_sample_fps=True,   ← 恒开
        │               image_patch_size=..., return_video_metadata=?)
        │   sample_fps 收进 video_sample_fps_list
        ▼
video_kwargs = {'do_sample_frames': False}
        │
        ├── return_video_metadata=False（Qwen2.5 兼容）
        │       └─ video_kwargs['fps'] = video_sample_fps_list
        │
        └── return_video_metadata=True（Qwen3）
                └─ 时间信息在 (video, metadata) 元组里，kwargs 不含 fps
        ▼
transformers: processor(text, videos=videos, video_metadata=[...], **video_kwargs)
vLLM:         {'prompt', 'multi_modal_data': {'video': [(v, meta), ...]},
               'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs}
```

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`do_sample_frames: False` 为什么必须恒为 False？什么场景下会出问题？

**答案**：因为 `qwen-vl-utils` 已在库内完成 `smart_nframes` 抽帧并**基于抽出的帧号**生成了 metadata 时间戳；若 processor 再按 fps 二次抽帧，画面帧数变了而 metadata 还是旧帧号，时间戳与画面将整体错位。只要走 `process_vision_info` 预处理路径，这个键就必须带上且为 False。

**练习 2**：`video_kwargs['fps']` 是列表而不是单个数，为什么？

**答案**：因为一条 messages 里可以有多个视频（u1-l3 的多视频输入），`video_sample_fps_list` 按顺序记录每个视频的实际采样率，processor 需要按同样顺序为各视频构造时间步；列表长度即视频个数。

**练习 3**：transformers 路径要 `zip(*videos)` 拆包，vLLM 路径却不拆，为什么？

**答案**：接口约定不同。transformers 的 `processor(...)` 参数要求 `videos`（张量列表）与 `video_metadata`（dict 列表）是两个平行参数，所以必须拆；vLLM 的 `multi_modal_data['video']` 约定每项就是 `(video, metadata)` 元组，由 vLLM 内部再转交给 processor，因此原样放入即可。两种接法运输的是同一份时间档案，只是封装不同。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `video_metadata` 是采样过程的时间档案：`fps`（原帧率）、`frames_indices`（采样帧的原视频帧号）、`total_num_frames`（原视频/区间总帧数）、`video_backend`（溯源）；帧时间戳 = `frames_indices[i] / fps`，总时长 = `total_num_frames / fps`。
- Qwen3-VL 用「文本-时间戳对齐」取代 T-RoPE：时间不再隐式藏进位置编码，而是由 metadata 显式随帧同行，支撑秒级事件定位；这是 `return_video_metadata` 开关存在的根本原因。
- `sample_fps`（实际采样率 = nframes ÷ 视频时长）只在 Qwen2.5 兼容分支进入 `video_kwargs['fps']`；Qwen3 模式下时间信息全部由 metadata 承载。

- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }

    ))
  )

  return { confirmed }
